name: io.github.chrischall/concur-mcp
description: Unofficial SAP Concur MCP for Claude — expense reports, expenses, receipts and trips

environmentVariables.name: CONCUR_DC
environmentVariables.description: Concur datacenter from your signed-in tab's host (e.g. us2, eu2). Defaults to us2.

environmentVariables.name: CONCUR_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port. Defaults to the fleet-shared 37149.

environmentVariables.name: CONCUR_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where `concur_get_receipt` saves downloaded receipts (never overwriting an existing file). Defaults to ~/Downloads/concur-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: CONCUR_UPLOAD_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: The only folders `concur_upload_receipt` will read from (a path-delimiter-separated list; `~` expanded). Hosted (with `MCP_DATA_DIR` set) the default is `$MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads`. Defaults to the working directory, ~/Downloads, ~/Documents and ~/Desktop.

environmentVariables.name: CONCUR_INLINE_RECEIPTS
environmentVariables.description: `true` makes `concur_get_receipt` return the image in the result instead of writing a file. Off locally, on when hosted.
